description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin for fullscreen functionality, including plugin info, initialization, control HTML, command execution, and toggling fullscreen mode.

classes.name: TinyMCE_FullScreenPlugin
classes.description: Object representing the fullscreen plugin for TinyMCE, including methods for plugin info, initialization, control HTML, command execution, and fullscreen toggling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance, optionally importing CSS for fullscreen mode.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for plugin controls, specifically the fullscreen button.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands such as toggling fullscreen mode based on user interaction.

methods.name: _toggleFullscreenWin
methods.description: Handles toggling fullscreen mode in a new window.

methods.name: _toggleFullscreen
methods.description: Handles toggling fullscreen mode within the current window, adjusting styles and layout.

methods.name: handleNodeChange
methods.description: Handles node changes during fullscreen mode, updating button states.
